title: OpenAI o1
before: Reasoning was prompted at inference time with chain-of-thought.
problem: Prompted reasoning is shallow, easily derailed, and not something the model was trained to do well.
breakthrough: Train the model with reinforcement learning to produce long internal reasoning before answering, and let it spend more tokens on harder problems.
why: It opened a second scaling axis and reset the field's direction. OpenAI disclosed no architecture or parameters, and hides the reasoning tokens.
next: o3 in December, then DeepSeek-R1 replicated the idea openly in January.
inherits: Reasoning trained in rather than prompted for.
